newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-TWO AUSTRIAN FIRST DIVISION CLUBS TO MERGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO AUSTRIAN FIRST DIVISION CLUBS TO MERGE.

text.p: Austrian first division soccer clubs LASK Linz and FC Linz will merge at the end of the season, club officials said on Wednesday.

Officials told a news conference the new club, which will play under the name of LASK Linz, would play in the current colours of LASK Linz -- black and white stripes and black shorts -- but use Linz's stadium.

LASK, formed in 1908, won both the Austrian League and Austrian Cup once, when they won the double in 1965. FC Linz, formed in 1946, won the league title in 1974 and were promoted back to the first division last season.
"We want a strong club which can challenge for the league title," Linzer ASK president Wolfgang Rieger said.
Linzer ASK are currently fifth in the league while FC Linz are one from bottom.
